# Input group

An input with addons inside its border: icons, text, buttons.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Content first</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Content first:** The search field, with a clear button and any icon beside a visible word. Not for separate fields.

- **Use it when:** A search with an icon and a clear button, a value with a unit or currency.
- **Not when:** Controls that are separate fields (lay them out with field).

Instead:

- [Input](./input.md): A plain field.

## Why it works this way

Input group looks the way it does because of 3 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Input group, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-iconography-roles"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What do icons do?</b><code>iconography.roles</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Actions, status and navigation</div><p>Occasional readers need icons for save, share and navigation.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-start</b>: The search icon before the text, with the visible label above the field.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: icon</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Input group decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-human-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How do people recall the interface?</b><code>human.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">They see it fresh each time</div><p>Visitors see the interface fresh each time.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-start</b>: The search icon before the text, with the visible label above the field.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>inline-end</b>: The clear button after the text, with a word: occasional visitors do not know icons.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: ghost</code> <code>Button: icon</code> <code>Button: disabled</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Input group decisions would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-tasks-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How often do people repeat actions?</b><code>tasks.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Rarely</div><p>Actions are rare: subscribe, share, save.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Input group</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-start</b>: Search is one line, and forms are rare and short.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>block-end</b>: Search is one line, and forms are rare and short.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: primary</code> <code>Button: large</code> <code>Field: horizontal</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Input group decisions would reopen</small><p>and 2 answers that follow from it: <b>Three</b>, <b>Only what today's screens use</b>.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] Addon buttons have names; icons that only decorate are hidden from screen readers. undefined

npx open-ds add input-group
